criteria.description: [R1, R2] `from app_int.main import round_currency` succeeds, and `round_currency` is callable with a single positional amount argument.
[R3, R10] For inputs Decimal("2.345"), 10, and 2.5, the return value is an instance of decimal.Decimal and its exponent (`result.as_tuple().exponent`) equals -2.

[R4] Positive ties round away from zero: round_currency(Decimal("2.345")) == Decimal("2.35"), round_currency(Decimal("2.335")) == Decimal("2.34"), round_currency(Decimal("0.005")) == Decimal("0.01"), round_currency(Decimal("1.125")) == Decimal("1.13").
[R4] Round-half-up is used, not banker's rounding: round_currency(Decimal("2.345")) != Decimal("2.34") and round_currency(Decimal("2.325")) == Decimal("2.33").
[R5] Negative ties round away from zero: round_currency(Decimal("-2.345")) == Decimal("-2.35") and round_currency(Decimal("-0.005")) == Decimal("-0.01").

[R6] Non-tie amounts round to the nearest cent: round_currency(Decimal("2.344")) == Decimal("2.34"), round_currency(Decimal("2.346")) == Decimal("2.35"), round_currency(Decimal("-2.344")) == Decimal("-2.34").

[R7, R9] Already-rounded amounts keep their value: round_currency(10) == Decimal("10.00"), round_currency(2.5) == Decimal("2.50"), round_currency(Decimal("2.34")) == Decimal("2.34"), round_currency(0) == Decimal("0.00").
[R8, R9] Float inputs round by their written decimal value: round_currency(2.345) == Decimal("2.35"), round_currency(1.005) == Decimal("1.01"), round_currency(-2.345) == Decimal("-2.35").
[R11] The existing tests pass unchanged: health_check() == {"status": "ok"} and add(2, 3) == 5.

[N1, N2] round_currency has a docstring that explicitly names the rounding mode (contains "half-up" or "half up", case-insensitive), and its signature has type annotations for the parameter and the return value.
[N3] The `dependencies` list in pyproject.toml is identical to the one on the base branch (no new runtime dependency).

[N4, N5] `uv run pytest -q` and `uv run ruff check .` both exit with status 0, and the test suite contains at least one test for round_currency covering a positive tie, a negative tie, a non-tie, an already-rounded value, and a float input.
